This analysis has not been independently reviewed or promoted for manuscript
use. It reads retained values and never runs the absorber during rendering.

## Question and basis

Does the self-contained Engine 1.0.0 wheel preserve the selected absorber model
when its removed equilibrium interface is replaced with native declared
problems and exact solved-state actions? The verification quantities are
speciation, CO₂ fugacity, liquid density, first derivatives, conserved elements
and charge. Agreement here supports numerical integration; it does not establish
physical accuracy or qualify another parameter set.

The wheel is `main-f4566b3d0c64d05822b41fe363de47ab5cfa6a0e`, SHA-256
`57bdf6c4277722fdf378107fa940fd321a4e9caeed8875165a27c318239dbd4a`.
Its ignored path, release verification and smoke-state comparison are retained in
[the adoption record](../../integration/epcsaft_adoption.json).

## Reaction reference and unchanged inputs

The packaged reactive bundle uses a fixed source-reference pressure of 100000 Pa.
The first migration probe accidentally used system pressure, 110900 Pa. That
probe gave 53023.89629802781 mol/m³ and 8712.07241134674 Pa; it is excluded from
acceptance. Preserving the declared pressure gives the corrected values below.
The input identities, stoichiometry and fitted coefficients are unchanged.

The earlier Engine resolved omitted same-sign dispersion choices to
`exclude-same-sign-ion-pairs` (`8438ce5f`, `records.py:285–289`,
`_resolve.py:752–759`). Its `_resolve.py:1076–1091` enabled both Born factors
when an explicit Born diameter and a neutral solvation factor different from
one were present. This bundle has explicit ionic Born diameters and water's
factor is 1.5, so both factors were 1.0. Current documents state those choices
explicitly with their Figiel (2025) lineage. Entries for excluded pairs are
removed because the current Engine refuses unconsumed coefficients. The
CO₂/MEA omission is declared explicitly, with provenance, in each current input.
These declarations preserve prior implicit behavior; they are not a new fit.

The test references were produced with Engine `9e1bef97` and wheel SHA-256
`b011d0f9d492e9db197f67cc0ae6781ac636fa3278805ddf1d6a05ecd167074b`.
That wheel could not be found in the cache or retained wheel directories, and its
original path no longer exists. Exact speciation and derivative replay on that
wheel is unavailable. The retained test values supply the earlier scalar
reference; conservation checks and independent centered differences verify the
current derivatives without loosening their tolerances.

## Diagnosed reference correction

At 318.15 K and 110900 Pa, the apparent CO₂/MEA/water amounts are
5.277293318431409, 9.729282110481522 and 76.97519250729157, normalized to one
mole of apparent feed. The source-reference pressure remains 100000 Pa.

| Quantity | Earlier test reference | Current exact reference | Finite-endpoint reconstruction using the current EOS |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Liquid density (mol/m³) | 53024.00899976211 | 53024.01128806487 | 53024.00899975503 |
| CO₂ fugacity (Pa) | 8710.019674586 | 8709.996035851034 | 8710.019674617202 |

Engine `bd7b6e388` (#353) replaced the 10⁻¹² mol/kg endpoint with a square-root
molality Richardson limit; `3b893fc2c` (#823) replaced extrapolation with analytic
infinite-dilution insertion. The diagnostic keeps the current EOS and parameters
fixed and changes only the reference evaluation. It reproduces the earlier
scalar references within 4×10⁻¹² relative. The first differing quantities are the
reference contractions: finite minus current is −2.437687×10⁻⁶ for R1/R2 and
−1.022890×10⁻⁵ for R3, in dimensionless logarithmic units. The R4/R5 differences
are at rounding scale.

The loading-jump check at 326.2714274736848 K, 109500 Pa and apparent amounts
3.979265359040124, 9.729875260332735 and 75.6233916590782 multiplies only
CO₂/water `k_ij` by 1.05. Its density reference changes from
50951.5005892302 to 50951.50163755171 mol/m³. The finite-endpoint reconstruction
gives 50951.50058923385 mol/m³. Both test references retain their 10⁻⁸ relative
tolerances. The owner approved these reference corrections after diagnosis.

The [retained diagnostic](../../integration/epcsaft_reference_diagnosis/reconstruct.py)
and its [reference](../../integration/epcsaft_reference_diagnosis/reference.json)
and [loading-jump](../../integration/epcsaft_reference_diagnosis/loading_jump.json)
records contain speciation, fugacity coefficients and Helmholtz contributions.
The migration uses `solve_equilibrium` and `solved_state_first_actions`.
The independent column directional check retains relative tolerance 2×10⁻⁵ and
absolute tolerance 2×10⁻⁸; element and charge checks retain their original bounds.

## Bounded reactive 3C calculation

The new [run](results/runs/reactive_3c_verified/result.json) uses the NCCC 2017 mass-input
3C basis with dry saturated vapor and reported dry gas mass. It solves the
seven-state, temperature-coordinate, single-bed column with the conventional
explicit enhancement factor and empirical energy balance. The initial mesh has
21 points, collocation tolerance is 0.5, boundary tolerance is 0.001, and the
maximum is 1000 nodes. A same-case Henry solution supplies only the starting
profile; the accepted equations use nine-species reactive thermodynamics.
The process has a 180 s external wall limit and a [log](results/runs/reactive_3c_verified.log).

| Quantity | Result |
|---|---:|
| Predicted CO₂ capture (%) | 91.54332138374535 |
| Final nodes / iterations | 22 / 2 |
| Maximum normalized RMS residual | 0.12534032558542918 |
| Maximum scaled boundary residual | 0 |
| Separate boundary residual norm | 3.121835483529044×10⁻¹⁴ |
| Solver wall time (s) | 4.945443868637085 |
| Total wall time including initialization and output (s) | 12.074213412999597 |
| Guard penalties / invalid-state evaluations | 0 / 0 |

The [independent conservation check](scripts/check_conservation.py) reads the
101 retained profile positions and compares true-species flows against the
apparent flows using independent C/H/N/O counts. Maximum element residuals are
7.71×10⁻¹³, 5.92×10⁻¹¹, 3.55×10⁻¹⁵ and 3.22×10⁻¹¹ mol/s, respectively.
The maximum charge residual is 2.07×10⁻¹² mol/s. Net CO₂ and water flow ranges
are 1.78×10⁻¹⁵ and 2.84×10⁻¹⁴ mol/s. Exact values are in
[conservation.json](results/runs/reactive_3c_verified/conservation.json).

The new run was executed from committed source `b1e46801fdec4c49685ba9a3b529d75074e37be5`.
All 70 recorded files under `src/` match the delivered tree, including
`reactive_bundle.py` SHA-256 `f191c15341f0d19ab54cf1b80d64c7d93a230b77912b4619dc996e34bd34db60`.
The [source verification](results/runs/reactive_3c_verified/source_verification.json)
also checks equal numerical settings. Capture differs from the earlier
91.54332138374535% result by **0 percentage points**; the maximum RMS residual,
scaled boundary residual and separate boundary residual norm each differ by zero.
The earlier `reactive_3c_final` run is retained and labeled superseded because
its source hashes predate the final implementation. Its recorded hashes are unchanged.

The solve used MA57. HSL, a collection of Fortran codes for large-scale
scientific computation. https://www.hsl.rl.ac.uk/

This is one bounded prediction and numerical verification, with no new mesh
refinement or physical-validation claim. The observation and parameter
uncertainties have not been assessed here. The empirical caloric closure remains
separate from the Engine thermodynamic reference.

## Remaining gate

The full suite gives 287 passes and two failures, both already present on the
old wheel. The two `test_segmented_bvp.py` checks for `positive_flow_pressure`
and its `case_bounded` alias fail on the ideal-Henry 3C calculation with a
singular collocation Jacobian and boundary residual norm 9958.17. They do not
call the Engine. A linear initial-guess probe also failed; removing duplicate
boundary scaling also failed (boundary residual norm 10503.3) within its 90 s
wall limit. Neither
probe changed retained implementation or tolerances. The owner assigned the
solver defect to separate work; both tests remain active.
